name: Divine Mercy
overview: Scripture reveals Divine Mercy as the unmerited favor of God that brings salvation not by human works but through His grace and mercy, as seen in Titus 3:5 and Ephesians 2:8. Despite humanity's sinfulness and the just consequence of death (Romans 6:23), God offers eternal life through Jesus Christ. This mercy is rooted in God's creative breath that gives life (Genesis 2:7) and invites wholehearted seeking of Him (Jeremiah 29:13), culminating in the glory shared between the Father and the Son before the world began (John 17:5).
